# James Bond: Box Office Revenue Over Time

This page examines how worldwide box-office revenue has changed across the James Bond franchise.

```{python}
#| echo: true

import pandas as pd
import matplotlib.pyplot as plt

films = pd.read_csv("films.csv")

bond = films[films["franchise"] == "James Bond"]
bond = bond.sort_values("year")
```

The James Bond films in this dataset span from `{python} int(bond["year"].min())` to `{python} int(bond["year"].max())`.

## Worldwide Revenue Over Time

The following figure illustrates how James Bond box-office revenue has changed across release years.

```{python}
#| label: fig-bond-revenue
#| fig-cap: "Worldwide box-office revenue of James Bond films over time"
#| echo: true

plt.figure(figsize=(8, 5))

plt.plot(
    bond["year"],
    bond["revenue_musd"],
    marker="o"
)

plt.xlabel("Release Year")
plt.ylabel("Worldwide Revenue (Million USD)")
plt.title("James Bond Worldwide Revenue Over Time")
plt.grid(True, alpha=0.3)
plt.show()
```
